note: Hetzner Online GmbH is a privately held, founder-owned (Martin Hetzner) German hosting/cloud company founded in 1997 in Gunzenhausen, Bavaria; no external VC funding, no accelerator involvement, and no acquisition. Financials are filed publicly in Germany's Bundesanzeiger (company register) as required by GmbH law; most recent publicly cited figures are for FY2021 (€367M revenue / €103M net income). Revenue has likely grown materially since 2021 given continued data-center expansion (Ashburn VA 2021, Singapore 2024), but no newer confirmed figure was found within the research window.
